title: Add the Last Two
summary: Test whether each term is built from the previous two.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: The differences are 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, which look like the sequence itself.
points: The differences are 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, which look like the sequence itself.

steps.title: The method: Add the two before
sentences: 1 plus 1 is 2, 1 plus 2 is 3, 2 plus 3 is 5, 3 plus 5 is 8.
Each number is the sum of the two numbers before it.
points: 1 plus 1 is 2, 1 plus 2 is 3, 2 plus 3 is 5, 3 plus 5 is 8.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: 5 plus 8 is 13, so the next number is 13.
You can see this pattern in many flowers and shells.
points: 5 plus 8 is 13, so the next number is 13.
